usable_improvement: A separately isolated collector/independent certificate-checker source correcting the two proved pre-execution omissions, with focused synthetic regression fixtures. The closed source/config/review remains unchanged.
bounded_question: Can final evidence duties retain independent error records and avoid reading child-owned output after failed collection; can an independent certificate reject a valid outside-bbox node attached to the wrong ambiguous column?
decision: A repair-only source and synthetic-fixture slice if fresh independent worth and root review support it; B preserve the two findings and leave this line held. No geometry worker, source-array decode, fixed-column trial or full constructor is admitted in this slice, including after fixture PASS.
scope: Copy only collector and independent observer into this leaf; original unrun source remains immutable. Keep producer/geometry/math untouched.

F1: independent containment for child result inspection, each output stat, final receipt attempt; finalized result hashing requires successful child collection, otherwise explicitly withheld. Persistence failure remains a failure and no durable receipt guarantee.
F2: independently check axis/other-axis identity, exact index types/ranges and correspondence to ambiguous column before nonboundary refusal credit.

Synthetic fixtures exercise fault outcomes and wrong-column rejection without target/worker/kernel import, archive access, process spawn or geometry. They may import new collector/observer with guarded main only.

At most two fixture invocations, each with a 5-second signal alarm, at most 64 tiny cases and <=4096 stdout bytes. No fault injection into the OS or product; use bounded synthetic file interfaces. Any unexpected failure after two invocations closes the repair without expanding scope.
Root independently reads critic handoff and verifies actual fixture outputs. Separate source/fixture review before any invocation. No sole passing tests promote any geometry or asset.

alternatives.choice: A narrow isolated repair and fault/certificate fixtures
alternatives.tradeoff: Makes a future independent collector/certificate review concrete; adds no garment or field and still requires new future geometry admission.

alternatives.choice: B preserve findings and move to another artist/product slice
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids more checker work, but the full-volume route remains blocked before its first source eligibility result.

preserve: Existing accepted/default/original/frozen/unused source and prior contract remain exact. All AAA/character/expression/wardrobe/physical/motion/performance ambitions retained. Fresh human steering wins.
